aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It utilizes and adds to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware that this approach significantly raises both upside and drawdown potential, and leveraged ETFs experience daily decay and rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage potential rapid losses.
